description: 1. Send first lead with type='special'. Since agent_1 satisfies all criteria, we should see it matches in the event listener immediately.
2. Send second 'special' lead. Should see no immediate match as agent_1 is busy.
3. Release agent_1. Since there's a PENDING lead that matches, should get matches immediately.
4. Send third special lead. Agent 1 is busy again, so should see no match.
5. Send general, tier 1, US-East lead. Should match agent_4 immediately.
6. Send general tier 4, US-East, lead. Should not match as no agent has tier >= 4.
7. Send a general, tier 1, US-East lead but with 'KO' language. Expect no match since no agents speak Korean.
8. Send another general, tier 1, US-East lead, EN language. Should match agent_5, as it has tier 3 >= 1.
